title: I'd Like a Plate of Noodles
summary: Siswa belajar nama makanan, minuman, dan wadahnya, memesan dengan sopan memakai would like, serta memberi pendapat dengan too/a little/very/really.
content:
## Tujuan Belajar

• Membicarakan makanan dan minuman.
• Memesan makanan dan minuman dengan sopan.
• Memberi pendapat tentang makanan dan minuman, baik positif maupun negatif.

## Kosakata Inti

Di unit ini kamu belajar nama makanan dan minuman bersama wadah atau takarannya, seperti a bowl of, a plate of, a cup of, a glass of, a serving of, dan a basket of. Kamu juga belajar kata rasa: sweet, salty, sour, spicy, hot, dan cold.

I'd like a bowl of fried rice and a glass of iced tea, please.
This soup is too salty for me.
We shared a basket of fruit for dessert.

## Tata Bahasa: Memesan dengan would like dan Memberi Pendapat (a little, very, really, too)

Would like adalah cara sopan untuk menyatakan keinginan, lebih sopan daripada I want. Pertanyaannya: What would you like to eat/drink? Jawabannya: I would like / I'd like + makanan, please. Jangan pakai "to" sebelum nama benda, dan pilih wadah yang tepat (a cup of coffee, bukan a plate of coffee).

Untuk menanyakan pendapat, pakai Do you like ...? (I/you/we/they) dan Does he/she like ...? Saat menjawab, perhatikan tunggal-jamak: this + benda tunggal + is, these + benda jamak + are. Kata penguat diletakkan sebelum kata sifat: a little (sedikit), very dan really (sangat), too (terlalu, bermakna negatif).

What would you like to eat? I'd like a plate of noodles, please.
What would you like to drink? I'd like a glass of juice, please.
Do you like your bowl of fried rice? Yes, it's really delicious.
Does she like her cup of coffee? No, it's too hot.
This glass of iced tea is a little sweet.
These fries are very salty.

## Contoh Percakapan

Waiter: Good evening. What would you like to eat?
Nadia: I'd like a bowl of soup and a plate of salad, please.
Waiter: And what would you like to drink?
Nadia: I'd like a glass of orange juice, please.
Arif: I'd like a burger, a serving of fries, and a can of soda, please.
Waiter: Here you are. Enjoy your meal!
Arif: Nadia, do you like your soup?
Nadia: Yes, it's really tasty, but it's a little spicy. Do you like your fries?
Arif: No, these fries are too salty!

## Ayo Berlatih

What would you like to eat for lunch today?
Contoh: I'd like a bowl of fried rice, please.

What would you like to drink on a hot day?
Contoh: I'd like a glass of iced tea, please.

What is your favorite food? How does it taste?
Contoh: My favorite food is chicken noodles. It is really delicious and a little spicy.

Do you like sour food? Why or why not?
Contoh: No, I don't. Lemons are too sour for me.

## Tips

• Saat memesan, gunakan "I'd like ..., please." agar terdengar sopan; hindari "I want ..." di restoran.
• Ingat pasangan yang benar: Do you / Does she, this bowl of soup is, these fries are.
